lines: Don't open it. That's not a baby.
In Mexico, they call her La Lechuza. A witch who turns into a giant owl... and cries like a baby, so children open the window.
But what if it's a real baby?
Real babies don't cry from the roof.
Lechuza is the Spanish word for barn owl. And barn owls don't hoot. They scream.
You overgrown feather duster! You moth-eaten pillow! Your mother was a pigeon!
shouting, furious, cracking at the end
Your feathers are... a bit messy?
You're not even a good baby! Real babies BREATHE between crying!
